_comment: Mock story for the demo day. Every beat fires at an anchor + offset_min on the SIM clock. State is recomputed from scratch each tick, so setting the clock backwards replays cleanly. Anchors: 'day' = midnight of the demo date (use 'at': 'HH:MM'); 't12' = T-12 opened (fired from the control panel or auto at its default); 'delay' = MBTA departure check; 'arrived' = engineer taps Arrived; 'gate' = commissioning gate opens (derived from cell.json). With auto=false, t12 and delay only happen when fired from the control panel. Text placeholders in {braces} are filled in by the mock.
